items.title: Senate rejects CLARITY Act cloture 49–50; Bitcoin slips below $76,000
US spot Bitcoin ETFs record $450.4M net outflow, largest since June
items.excerpt: Thirteen US-listed funds shed $450.4 million on Tuesday, the largest day since late June. Fidelity and BlackRock led the withdrawals as Bitcoin fell 2.5%.

items.title: Bitcoin holds near $75,700 as the Fed decision and a stalled market-structure bill land on the same day
items.excerpt: Price clustered in a $75,400–$76,100 band into Wednesday. The FOMC statement and a failed CLARITY cloture vote sit on the same calendar.
